scientific_integrity: Analytic all-graph proof; finite exact-arithmetic checks are supplemental. Bibliographic priority is not independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple d-regular graphs, 0<c<1/d, exact normalized singleton minimizations, state-independent two-step sampling; one-pair conditional energy only, not multistep rates or runtime.
title: Uniform oriented-edge sampling is minimax for two successive coordinate solves on regular graphs
